notes.content:
Here's an optimized interface modification plan for manual role upgrades with an experience pool system:
﻿
1. Role Interface Changes:
- Remove automatic level progression
- Add "Upgrade" button next to level indicator
﻿
2. New Experience Pool System:
- Visual bar at bottom of main interface (semi-transparent overlay)
- Dynamic counter: "EXP Pool: [Amount]"
- Animation when gaining EXP (particle effects optional)
- Tooltip: "Accumulated experience for manual upgrades"
﻿
3. Upgrade Interface:
- Accessible via Role page
- Shows:
• Current level
• Next level requirements
• Available EXP in pool
• Upgrade cost for next level
- "Upgrade" button (enabled when EXP sufficient)
- Optional: Preview of stat gains
The system maintains clean visibility while giving players full control over progression, with clear feedback at each step. The EXP pool display is non-intrusive but always accessible for strategic planning.
